why: Round 19, the user's ruling on REVIEW_v18_generic section #2 ("Numbers too long"): "These are all Referee takes. Al should not be replacing referee takes. Leave these stock." Every one of the 386 staged `numbers` takes is the same family -- the PA reading a jersey number, 'Number forty-eight.' -- so the ruling is phase-wide, not just the 123 that overran their slot. The cue NAMES are misleading here (PA_Name_Last_Niemi_Take2_Var7 says 'Number forty-eight'); the family is the `said`.
binding: Refused, not deferred. Nothing in this list may be installed, and no review tree may serve it again -- re-serving a take the user has already ruled on is the fault of project_review_baseline_publishes_shipped. The staged WAVs are LEFT ON DISK on purpose: the stage is the generator's resume guard, and deleting them would make the next run re-roll all 386 on the GPU.
why_hype_french_penalty_run: NOT a user ruling -- a gate finding, recorded here because this file is the only mechanism that can stop an install. Hype register indices 730..784 (1B:0x07692000 PA_PenderDucks .. 1B:0x077F1800 PA_KeepOnVisit) are ONE contiguous run of the stock FRENCH announcer's penalty family, 'Penalite des <club>' / 'pour l'equipe <nation>'. The run is bracketed by English on both sides (PA_Penalty_<Nation> below, PA_Penalty_HomeTeam/_AwayTeam/PA_PenaltyOn above), so membership is decided by ADDRESS and admits no exceptions. Al is the ENGLISH PA voice; PA French is a separate tier, so an Al take here costs the French tier its asset. Six of the 55 -- PA_Hurricanes 0735, PA_Panthers 0742, PA_Canadians 0744, PA_Blues 0752, PA_MapleLeafs 0754, PA_Canooks 0755 -- walked past pa_french_gate because whisper collapses the French to a clean-looking English 'and the <club> are', so BOTH the name and the transcript read English. Found 2026-09-08 when the carrier staged an Al 'Hendo Panthers' over 1B:0x076C3000. Three (0735, 0752, 0754) were already live and are being reverted to stock. The gate now lists all six by name; this list is the second line of defence.
why_french_address_blocks: Every cue that pa_french_gate now flags -- by NAME or by ADDRESS BLOCK -- is refused here as well, because pa_generic_install ships whatever WAV it finds and never asks the gate. The blocks were added 2026-09-08 after PA_HYPE_0917 (PA_PrussianTirupoDetroit, "Prochain tireur pour Detroit") was found LIVE with Al English over it: most French cue names in this bank are ASR garble (PA_Sisigo, PA_Sekum, PA_2nd, PA_Even) and their transcripts are garble too, so both text axes read English. Six live cues were reverted from 1B.orig: palines.bin 1718/1936/2654 (hype) and 1559/1561/1753 (counts). PA_HYPE_0145 and PA_HYPE_0405 are EXEMPT -- the user listened to those and approved them.

_notes.penalty_referee_voice_round20: The penalty family ships TWICE, the same lines in two voices. Round 20, the user listened to four A/B pairs and ruled: PA_PENALTY_0001/0017/0033/0039 are the PA announcer (Al may replace those); PA_PENALTY_0004/0022/0064/0070 are the REFEREE -- "Those are in fact identical lines with different voices." Al must not replace referee calls (round 18: "These are all Referee takes. Al should not be replacing referee takes. Leave these stock."). The discriminator is PITCH, not the cue-index block: 32 addressable penalty cues sit at 142-190 Hz (PA) and 117 at 240-277 Hz (referee), a clean 50 Hz gap. Cues 3084/3085 are inside the 2851-3159 index block but are PA-register, so the block cannot be used as the test. All 117 referee cues were live with Al and were reverted to shipped bytes from 1B.orig on 2026-09-09, byte-verified 117/117.

_notes.hype_0946_refusal_lifted_round22: PA_HYPE_0946 PA_Atlanta was refused in round 20 with the referee batch. The user lifted it in round 22: 'All of those Atlanta calls that you mention (you said I refused the referee take) should be replaced with Winnipeg.' It was never a referee take -- its f0 is 183 Hz, inside the 141-190 Hz PA-announcer register, not the 240-277 Hz referee register ([[project_penalty_calls_exist_in_two_voices]]). It is the bare city fragment that plays in front of 'penalty to', so leaving it Atlanta while PA_Penalty_Atlanta says Winnipeg would split the sentence between two clubs.
_notes.numbers_r23_pa_voice_lifted: Round 23. The user's ruling was 'These are all Referee takes. Al should not be replacing referee takes.' -- but the revert took the WHOLE index block: 263 cues removed when only 164 were the referee. These 83 tags were decoded from the live bank and each one says 'number' in ENGLISH at or below 190 Hz, the English PA register -- not the referee at 240+, and not the French 'numero' takes that share the same block. Refusal lifted on his instruction: 'Restore the 99 PA number takes and generate the missing ones.' The 164 referee tags stay refused, and so do 15 English takes at 205-236 Hz whose voice is not settled -- those go to his ear first.
_notes.numbers_r23_unsettled_lifted: Round 23. The restore gate held back 16 reverted `numbers` takes whose stock clip sat at 205-236 Hz -- above the PA register I had measured, below the referee. User ruled by ear on 2026-09-09: "all of these are PA_English reads (just, the stock PA not Al)". So the pitch threshold was wrong, not the takes: an EXCITED English PA read runs 200+ Hz. PA_NUMBERS_0001 is in this set too -- whisper heard the stock clip as 'Ford', but the register line is 'four.', so it was a mis-transcription, not a misrouted row. The 164 referee tags stay refused.
